STG-FAIR.role: Texas Task Force 1 Alpha and Bravo stage here from D-1 13:00 local (convoy TF1-CC-0913 arrives 18:47 local).

_availability.note: Mutual-aid and state/federal units are not in the area before the storm. Arrival: TF1-ALPHA/BRAVO D-1 18:47 local; San Patricio and Bee County dispatch mutual aid at D0; MTF-9 arrives D+6 and stands down from D+8; civilian boat pool integrated D+3 (87 hulls, GPS trackers on); welfare-check teams (8) work from D+5 17:00 local.

WC-1.role: Two-person welfare-check units answer the 11 false 'trapped survivor' calls near SUB-02 and SUB-03, D+7 to D+10 (T17/T13).
